title: refactor(app-shell): the Studio design surface picks with the shared Select (objectui#11865, slice o)
body:
Part of #11865
Clause-②: no

Slice o of claim `6073419396` on objectui#11865: the Studio design surface (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`). The card stays open for slice p (`ListView`, `ChatbotEnhanced`), which a sibling PR carries.

## What changed

`StudioDesignSurface` drew five pickers as browser-native select elements. Counted before the first edit: the census's five lines are all real elements, each with its closing tag, and none is a comment line. Each now uses the shared Radix `Select` (`@object-ui/components`) through one module-private `StudioPicker`:

- the nav-item inspector's *Link object* (`StudioNavItemInspector`);
- its target picker, `NavTargetSelect`, for a page, dashboard, report, action, component or doc entry (*Doc page* and *Book* included);
- a url entry's *Open in* (`NavUrlFields`);
- *New object*'s record sharing (OWD), in the Data pillar's create dialog;
- *New automation*'s trigger under *Advanced*, in the Automations pillar's create dialog.

`StudioPicker` follows the card's landed slices (`RulePicker`, `CreatePicker`):

- Items carry their option's index, not its value. So the `''` options ("Choose object", "Choose", "Choose later on the Start node") need no empty `SelectItem`, which Radix refuses.
- A value no option carries gets an item of its own, labelled with the value and listed first. Picking it writes nothing.
- `onPick` receives the picked option's own value, the string the native `change` carried.

No native select element is left in the file, and the tag spelling is in no comment either.

**Not touched:** every write path (`bindObject`, `setTarget`, `setAction`, `setCreateOwd`, `setNewTrigger` and the saves behind them), `packages/components/src/ui/**`, `packages/i18n/**`, the designer tables, `ListView.tsx`, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` and the eager-closure budget script.

Files: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the new pin `StudioDesignSurface.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`, fourteen existing studio-design suites that drove these controls, and `.changeset/11865-o-studio-surface-shared-select.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell: patch`).

## The dispatch's hypotheses, measured

A scratch probe (uncommitted, deleted) mounted the base surface (`2063f7a96`) and fired `change` on every option of every native control, with the fixtures the pin uses. It recorded the write, the accessible name (dom-accessibility-api) and the shown option.

- **H1, value parity: holds.**
  - 52 nav-inspector rows across 18 entries compare `onNavPatch`'s value as JSON text, plus the keys the written entry holds as `undefined`. JSON erases those keys, and the unbind writes `type`, `objectName` and `object` as `undefined`.
  - 3 record sharing rows compare the *New object* save call as JSON text, and the untouched default saves the same `private`.
  - 10 trigger rows compare the saved flow as JSON text. "Choose later on the Start node" saves a Start node with no `config`.
  - Re-picking the current option writes nothing. The probe's `change` fired for the current option too, which a browser's native select does not do, so those rows pin the primitive.
- **H2, names, keyboard, read-only.**
  - Names: *Page*, *Dashboard*, *Report*, *Action*, *Component*, *Doc page*, *Book* and *Open in* keep their `label htmlFor` names; the `id` moved onto the trigger.
  - *Trigger* keeps the name its wrapping label gave it.
  - The record sharing picker keeps its wrapping label's whole text as its name: caption, the chosen model's gloss and the hint, as on base. The pin reads it before and after a pick.
  - *Link object* had no accessible name on base (its label has no `htmlFor`) and still has none. Its trigger carries `data-testid="nav-link-object"` so suites can find it.
  - Keyboard: Enter opens and Enter on an option selects, pinned on *Link object* and *Trigger*.
  - Read-only: none of the five has such a state. A read-only package closes nav editing, which unmounts the inspector, and offers no *New object*. The pins for those two are `StudioDesignSurface.navEditClosesOnReadOnly-11167` ("closes nav editing and the linked item’s inspector") and `StudioDesignSurface.emptyPackage` ("hides the CTA on a read-only package"). The Automations rail's *New* is gated on the same `readOnly` in the source, and no suite pins it.
- **H3, a stored value outside the options: holds.**
  - An object entry bound to `ghost_obj` now shows `ghost_obj`, listed first. The native control showed "— Choose object —".
  - A url entry holding `_top` now shows `_top`. The native control showed "Same tab".
  - `NavTargetSelect` already listed an outside target as its own option on base, and it still does.
  - The two dialogs' values are component state that only ever holds an option.
- **H4, first-load bytes: −2 B gzip, 0 B raw.**
  - Measured with `apps/console` `CI=true vite build` under the verify lock. Base `2063f7a96`: `eagerGzipBytes` 3237430, raw 10893710, 289 of 2474 chunks eager. Head `2d046a08a`: 3237428, raw 10893710, 289 of 2474.
  - The only mover is the entry `index` chunk: 0 raw, −2 gzip, from renamed lazy hashes.
  - `StudioDesignSurface` ships in the lazy `studioBuilder` chunk on both legs. `ui-components` and `vendor-radix` were already eager.
  - `check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` on the head build: "Console eager closure is 3161.6 KB gzipped across 289 of 2474 chunks (budget: 3204.6 KB, headroom: 43.0 KB)."

## Tests

- **New pin**, `StudioDesignSurface.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`, 79 tests:
  - each picker is the Radix combobox trigger, with no native select left;
  - names, option order, the 65 write rows, outside values and the keyboard.
- **Fourteen existing suites** drove the native controls with `fireEvent.change`, or read `.value`, `.options` or `toHaveValue`. Each now opens the primitive's list and picks by label, or reads the trigger's text and the listed labels:
  - `navItemInspector`, `navItemInspectorLabel-11196`, `navItemInspectorLabelMaps-11148`, `standardNavEntries-11201` and `navItemTypes-11790`;
  - `navPlaceholderSave-11776`, `navAutosaveFlush-11189`, `navEditClosesOnReadOnly-11167`, `autosaveInFlight-11204`, `autosaveSwitch-11232` and `InterfacesPillar.heldWidget-11910`;
  - `createObjectOwd`, `newFlowTrigger-11788` and `flowPresets-11861`.
  
  No expected value changes meaning. One read would have gone vacuous on the trigger: `flowPresets-11861` read the trigger picker's `.value` as `''`, which a button's `.value` also is. It now reads the trigger's text.
- **Reverse leg**, from committed `a7e59648e`, with a trap restore:
  - `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` was written from its base blob `9d6ced42` (hash proved, 5 native selects, 0 `StudioPicker`).
  - The pin plus the fourteen suites read 'Test Files 15 failed (15)', 'Tests 127 failed | 65 passed (192)'.
  - The pin is red in 77 of 79. Green by design: the *Trigger* name, and the untouched record-sharing default.
  - The fourteen suites are red in 50 tests.
  - Restore: `git checkout HEAD --`, disk blob `656f270d` equal to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes.

## Gates (head `2d046a08a`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` from the repo root, under the lock, over 190 files: every suite that imports or names `StudioDesignSurface` or a pillar (188), plus `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` and `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`. Result: 'Test Files 190 passed (190)', 'Tests 1601 passed (1601)', VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` ('tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json') exits 0. It ran after the closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build` (Scope: 29 of 47). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all 16 touched ts/tsx files.
- `pnpm exec eslint --format json` on the 16 touched files: 0 errors and 13 warnings, all in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. The per-rule counts equal its base blob's (stdin): set-state-in-effect 5, exhaustive-deps 6, preserve-manual-memoization 2. The test files read 0 / 0.
- Each exits 0:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ('16 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)');
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`;
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` ('0 new citation(s)');
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`;
  - `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:handler-key-reads` and `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only).
- Declared to CI: the full `pnpm test` farm and repo-wide `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- *Link object* has no accessible name, on base as on head: its caption label has no `htmlFor`. Naming it is outside this control swap, and no public-door reading was taken.
- The *Trigger* and record sharing pickers stay inside their wrapping labels, as the card's earlier pickers do, so the labels keep naming them. A click on such a label's other text now reaches the trigger as a click. NOT MEASURED in a browser: whether it opens the list there.
- Browser: NOT MEASURED. Keyboard and names are pinned in the test DOM only.
